title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.18: Spectacle reworked — it now plays all Tuned cards in a random order (at most once per turn) and then removes Tuned from all cards, instead of turning them into Planned cards. The whole board fires while still Tuned, so every card gets its full bonus. Upgrade now grants Retain instead of reducing the cost.
